chapter.heading: Qualifications of Overseers
chapter.v:
This is
a faithful saying: If a man desires the position of a bishop, he desires a good work.

one who
rules his own house well, having his children in submission with all reverence [Mark 16:20]

not a
novice, lest being puffed up with pride he fall into the same condemnation as the devil. [Job 7:17; Ps.]

Moreover he
must have a good testimony among those who are outside, lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.Qualifications of Deacons

Likewise deacons
must be reverent, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy for money, [Matt. 28:18]

holding the
mystery of the faith with a pure conscience. [Phil. 2:7-9;]

But let
these also first be tested; then let them serve as deacons, being found blameless.

Likewise, their
wives must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things. [Heb. 10:10]

Let deacons
be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well. [Ps. 22:22]

For those
who have served well as deacons obtain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.The Great Mystery [2 Sam. 22:3;]

but if
I am delayed, I write so that you may know how you ought to conduct yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth. [Ps. 68:18; Is.]

And without
controversy great is the mystery of godliness:God was manifested in the flesh,Justified in the Spirit,Seen by angels,Preached among the Gentiles,Believed on in the world,Received up in glory.
